_about: Owned by the image session. Profile and deck read it through collateral/brand/det.js. Set status to "ready" per item when its files exist; set complete: true when all are done.

spec.base: 2400x1350 JPEG (16:9), graded cool like the site
spec.overlay: SVG with viewBox "0 0 2400 1350", vector only, IBM Plex text
spec.safeArea: all detections, chips and pointers inside x 300–2100 (central 4:3), y 60–1290
spec.png: 2400x1350 flattened PNG for the image pack

cover-site.brief: Wide industrial scene: several workers, a forklift and machines, multiple live detections (PPE ok boxes, a zone, a vehicle with speed, one exception).
cover-site.alt: Wide warehouse hall with racking, two forklifts and staff; a parked forklift and a moving one tracked, a forklift-lane zone, and one pedestrian flagged in the lane.

guard-ppe-crew.brief: Crew PPE check: helmet and vest boxes per person. Only "ok" chips on recognisable faces; any violation only on a person seen from behind or far away.
guard-ppe-crew.alt: Three construction workers measuring a block wall; each helmet and hi-vis vest detected and passed.

guard-forklift-proximity.brief: Forklift and pedestrian: vehicle box with speed, person box, distance line with metres, proximity ring.
guard-forklift-proximity.alt: Worker in a helmet and ear defenders, seen from behind, near a parked forklift; helmet passed, forklift tracked as parked and the 2.4 m distance to the worker measured against a 3.0 m limit.

guard-restricted-zone.brief: Restricted zone polygon around a robot cell or press; person approaching, zone armed/breach chip.
guard-restricted-zone.alt: Robot cell with an industrial robot and press; restricted zone R-07 armed around the robot reach with no persons inside.

guard-work-at-height.brief: Work at height: harness detected, lanyard/hook pointer, tie-off status chip.
guard-work-at-height.alt: Worker in a harness painting a tank wall at height; helmet and harness detected, lanyard on the dorsal D-ring, anchor point out of view.

inspect-surface-defect.brief: Machined or cast part: localised anomaly heat map on one scratch, defect box, width/length pointer, reject chip.
inspect-surface-defect.alt: Two machined flanges on a drawing; one passes, the other is rejected for a scratch highlighted by an anomaly heat map.

inspect-pack-label.brief: Packs: OCR boxes on batch and expiry text, read values, pass chips, one mismatch.
inspect-pack-label.alt: Blister strips of tablets on a packing line; every pocket in view on two strips verified, one crushed pocket on a tray flagged for reject.

inspect-pcb.brief: Circuit board: component presence and polarity boxes, one missing/rotated part flagged.
inspect-pcb.alt: Bare circuit board with a chip being placed by tweezers; chip rotation flagged, pin-1 polarity confirmed and the next footprint to place marked.

inspect-colour.brief: Tiles or textile rolls: colour sampling grid with ΔE values per lot, one out of tolerance.
inspect-colour.alt: Stacks of patterned ceramic tiles with colour sampling grids; one lot passes at ΔE 0.8, another is held at ΔE 2.4 against a 1.5 limit.

sense-steam-leak.brief: Valve or pipe with vapour: leak region box, valve tag, trend pointer.
sense-steam-leak.alt: Steam escaping between pipes and cladding at an industrial plant; vapour regions boxed and valve V-12 flagged with a rising trend.

sense-gauge.brief: Analog pressure gauge: needle reading 6.4 bar, range arc with limits, tag PI-204.
sense-gauge.alt: Close-up of a 0–16 bar pressure gauge; PI-204 read at 6.4 bar inside its 4.0–8.0 bar normal band, with H and HH limits and a 24-hour trend.

sense-thermal-panel.brief: Electrical panel with a thermal hot-spot overlay on one breaker/terminal, temperature chip (e.g. 84 °C), limit.
sense-thermal-panel.alt: Open control cabinet with a thermal overlay; relay K14 flagged at 84 °C against a 70 °C limit, a terminal warm at 63 °C, the PLC normal.

sense-walkway-spill.brief: Spill on a marked walkway: spill polygon, walkway zone, "Spill · walkway W2" chip.
sense-walkway-spill.alt: Forklift charging bay with a marked central walkway; oil on walkway W2 outlined as a spill with a clean-up task, nearby drips flagged.

flow-conveyor.brief: Bulk conveyor: belt edge lines with drift (+41 mm), load reading, hot idler (Idler 11 · 86 °C), foreign object box.
flow-conveyor.alt: Quarry conveyor head pulley discharging gravel; belt drift of +41 mm at the pulley edge, load reading, a foreign object and a warm bearing flagged.

infra-pier-crack.brief: Concrete crack: traced crack line, width gauge "D-014 · w 3.5 ± 0.2 mm", length, change vs 2025 (+0.4 mm).
infra-pier-crack.alt: Close-up of a cracked concrete pier with a fern; crack D-014 traced and measured at 3.5 mm wide, vegetation D-015 boxed.

infra-road-defects.brief: Road surface seen from a survey vehicle: pothole and crack boxes with class and size.
infra-road-defects.alt: Damaged asphalt road seen from a survey vehicle; two potholes boxed with sizes, longitudinal and transverse cracks traced, segment marked for repair.

infra-tower.brief: Transmission tower: insulator string boxes, one flagged (e.g. broken disc / corrosion), drone survey framing.
infra-tower.alt: Transmission tower seen from below; insulator strings boxed, one string flagged for a broken disc and another for cap corrosion.

inspect-closures.brief: Plastic caps/closures in bulk or on a conveyor: short shot, flash, tamper-band damage, black speck, one cap ΔE 2.4, most caps ok.
inspect-closures.alt: Plastic bottle caps on a table seen from above; one cap from lot 24-118 flagged at ΔE 2.4 against a 1.5 limit, a small inclusion marked for review, other caps passed, with a shift tally of defect classes.

inspect-capping-line.brief: Filling line capper exit: caps present and seated, one skewed/high cap (warn), one tamper band not engaged (bad), fill level ok, header chip.
inspect-capping-line.alt: Filled bottles with green caps leaving the capper; caps in the inspection lane checked as seated, one cap high by 0.6 mm for review, one tamper band not engaged and rejected, fill level ok.

guard-moulding-cell.brief: Injection-moulding cell: Guard danger zone at the mould/ejection area, PPE ok on operators seen from behind, person-in-zone count.
guard-moulding-cell.alt: Generic automated press and robot cell (stock photo, not an injection-moulding machine); press 4 tracked while cycling inside an armed danger zone, light curtain ok and no persons in the zone.
